mapper.select: SELECT membership.membership_id, identity.login_name FROM organization_access.tenant_membership membership JOIN organization_access.subject_identity identity ON identity.subject_id = membership.subject_id JOIN organization_access.member_conversation_features features ON features.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND features.membership_id = membership.membership_id WHERE membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.membership_role = 'TENANT_USER' AND membership.status = 'ENABLED' AND identity.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT membership.member_access_pending_revocation AND AND strpos(lower(identity.login_name), lower(#{q})) > 0 ORDER BY membership.membership_id DESC

SELECT p.policy_id, p.name, v.assistant_name, v.status, v.version_id, v.version_number FROM organization_access.access_policy p JOIN organization_access.access_policy_version v ON v.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND v.policy_id = p.policy_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND v.version_number = (SELECT max(latest.version_number) FROM organization_access.access_policy_version latest WHERE latest.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND latest.policy_id = p.policy_id)
AND (strpos(lower(p.name), lower(#{q})) > 0 OR strpos(lower(v.assistant_name), lower(#{q})) > 0)
AND v.status = #{status} ORDER BY p.policy_id DESC
